name: Collaboration and Project Multiplayer
description: League of Legends mental model: users are champions, agents are minions, projects are the map, lanes are workstreams. Models presence, cursors, live project state, agent assignments, contested resources, locks/fences, review queues, shared artifacts, merge pressure, conflict resolution, and real-time cockpit state.
objective: Model and implement real-time multiplayer collaboration with presence, locks, conflict resolution, and shared project state.
